scope: PostgreSQL timestamptz[] export, binding and SQL replay across session time zones

checks.command: rtk proxy cargo test --locked -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration array_contract:: -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1
rtk proxy cargo clippy --locked -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

assertions: The test runs the source expression and file-writer consumer in an America/New_York transaction session; the independent PostgreSQL array text and array_to_json oracles retain the two distinct fall-back offsets.
BookiE's decoded timestamptz[] remains canonical UTC text, and typed rebinding reproduces the original array_send bytes.
JSON and CSV preserve the exact UTC array text; the XLSX writer retains a string cell and emits no formula for it.
SQL-file replay in the New York session, followed by a read under Asia/Kathmandu, preserves the original native array_send bytes.
remaining: Other temporal-array session and consumer combinations, other spreadsheet applications, and the broader B3 matrix remain open.
